channel.title: Microsoft SOC Brief
channel.description: Due within 7 days, new since the last brief, Microsoft changes in Graph and roles

item.title: [Due in 1 day] Stricter Conditional Access evaluation can break Teams Android device sign-in from late September
item.description: Teams · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 1 day] App Governance permissions change for three Entra roles as Defender XDR Unified RBAC takes over
item.description: Defender XDR · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 1 day] The legacy Microsoft Graph security alerts API (/security/alerts) stops returning data after 15 October, and its replacement does not return every alert the old one did
item.description: Graph · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 2 days] Loading Power Query data to Python in Excel Web: Retirement
item.description: M365 Apps · Due in 2 days · deadline 2026-10-16

item.title: [Due in 5 days] EntraIdSignInEvents replaces AADSignInEventsBeta on 19 October 2026
item.description: Defender XDR · Due in 5 days · deadline 2026-10-19

item.title: [Due in 1 day] Three Entra roles change what they can do in App Governance
item.description: Entra · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Production PCA 2011 expiry and next-generation code signing
item.description: Windows · Due in 5 days · deadline 2026-10-19

item.title: [Due in 1 day] Autopatch gains separate control over quality updates, .NET Framework and quick machine recovery
item.description: Windows · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 6 days] SharePoint starts reporting site metadata size and warning on it
item.description: SharePoint · Due in 6 days · deadline 2026-10-20

item.title: [Due in 5 days] Entra sign-in pages start enforcing a Content Security Policy in mid-October; injected scripts stop running on login.microsoftonline.com
item.description: Entra · Due in 5 days · deadline 2026-10-19

item.title: [Due in 1 day] SharePoint one-time passcode retirement slips: Phase 2 now starts mid-October and runs to the end of November
item.description: SharePoint · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [Due in 1 day] Defender for Cloud Apps switches the SaaS accounts integration with Identity inventory on automatically from 15 October
item.description: Defender XDR · Due in 1 day · deadline 2026-10-15

item.title: [New] Entra stops auto-granting AgentIdentity.CreateAsManager to agent blueprints from 4 November; app-only agents that create their own identities need explicit admin consent or get 403
item.description: Entra · New · deadline 2026-11-04

item.title: [New] From 4 November every default user can create agent blueprints unless 'Users can create agent blueprints' is set to No
item.description: Entra · New · deadline 2026-11-04

item.title: [New] Windows Hello for Business and macOS Platform SSO as standalone MFA factors: completion moves from late November to mid-December 2026
item.description: Entra · New

item.title: [New] AD FS DKM container ACL hardening is now in enforcement with the October Windows security update
item.description: Windows Server · New

item.title: [New] Windows 11 security baselines turn Administrator protection on by default from the October update
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] ReFS on removable media: audit from the October update, blocking by default from the January 2027 update
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] The October 2026 Windows security update is available
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] Windows 11 24H2 Home and Pro and Windows 10 LTSB 2016 have reached end of updates
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] The October 2026 Scan Cab (wsusscn2.cab) is delayed
item.description: Windows · New

item.title: [New] Purview RBAC audit: two new operations, and role-group and permission-assignment records now say which portal made the change
item.description: Purview · New

item.title: [New] Agent usage and activity metrics in the Microsoft 365 admin center no longer need an Agent 365 licence for Microsoft-built agents (late November)
item.description: Microsoft 365 · New

item.title: [New] Copilot Studio retires GPT-4.1, GPT-5 Chat/Auto/Reasoning and GPT 5.6 Sol/Luna on 12 November and migrates agents automatically
item.description: Copilot Studio · New · deadline 2026-11-12

item.title: [New] October 2026 Exchange Server security updates for Subscription Edition, 2019 and 2016
item.description: Exchange Online · New
